productionProof.runMeaning: Content-addressed completed response identity; identical analyses may share an id. Not a unique wall-clock execution identifier.
productionProof.bodyBytes: Existing successful producer/replay bodies are unchanged. Proof compares the same JSON encoding used by the existing completed-result writer, preserving Date/optional-field serialization compatibility. The new export serializes only the retained result; its original transport bytes are SHA-256 hashed before optional metadata embedding. The resultHash separately identifies canonical retained JSON, not original historical HTTP bytes.

producerBindingCoverage.conditions: Only a persisted completed response whose manifest scenario matches the producer allowlist, exact canonical result matches and referenced material archive verification succeeds receives proof. For current producer responses its scenario must also match the exact captured actual route, and manifest/material/workbook/ordered-overlay/indicator identities must match the server-written resolved input-context response headers. Request headers, query strings and browser state never grant proof.
producerBindingCoverage.legacyStoredResults: Bodies remain readable unchanged but producer identity stays unavailable; exact producer export refuses without a verified material bundle.
producerBindingCoverage.unretainedCurrentResponses: No producer proof is attached. No current-source lookup, recomputation or caller certification is substituted.
producerBindingCoverage.unsupportedCoverage: Derived chart/XLSX view rows, other server disclosures, legacy physical projections, FaIR artifacts and submitted diagnostics are not upgraded to complete producer bindings by this increment.
producerBindingCoverage.remainingAssociationGap: The retained producer manifest and resolved server snapshot context bind this completed response, not a caller's desired UI state. This increment does not independently trace every calculator read, attest a running executable/container against the archived source bundle, recalculate stored outputs, establish source publication vintage or certify every raw query/settings parameter as independently consumed.
